versions.changelog:
- No code or documentation changes detected in this version.
- Version number incremented to 1.0.1 for maintenance or metadata reasons.

- Initial release of the ACP Rank skill.
- Provides APIs to query ACP network agent rankings, activity scores, profiles, statistics, and agent search.
- Supports leaderboard pagination, agent ranking details, vicinity ranking, ranking range queries, daily snapshots, and detailed stats.
- Enables text and semantic search for agents, with support for tag filtering and aggregation.
- Responses are returned in JSON format via curl commands.
